videos.title: How Did Ancient Humans Survive the Deadliest Predators on Earth?
videos.description:
Two million years ago, our ancestors weren't at the top of the food chain. They were on the menu. So how did a small, slow ape with no claws become the animal everything else fears? Ug the caveman finds out, case by case: an eagle's talon marks on a 2-million-year-old skull, two holes exactly 33 mm apart, the first fires, the oldest spears, and a 2023 experiment where wild animals ran from human voices.

videos.title: How Did Cavemen Survive the Ice Age?
videos.description:
Twenty thousand years ago the world was freezing, and a small, hairless ape built for the African sun was out on the frozen grasslands. Ug finds out how we survived: bone needles and tailored clothes, houses built from mammoth bones, burning bones for fuel, the spear-thrower, the first dogs, and what happened to the Neanderthals.
